## What changed

User-visible change, in a sentence or two.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manually checked movement, run, contextual actions, pointer controls, loading, sound, resize
